name: GW AI Website Builder
author: GravityWrite

sections.description:
GW AI Website Builder is a powerful WordPress website builder plugin that uses artificial intelligence to create complete, professional websites in minutes. Whether you need a business website, blog, portfolio, landing page, or online store — this AI-powered site builder handles it all without writing a single line of code.

Built on top of Elementor, the most popular WordPress page builder, this plugin combines AI content generation with drag-and-drop visual editing. Choose from a library of ready-made Elementor templates, customize layouts instantly, and launch responsive websites faster than ever.

Perfect for small business owners, freelancers, agencies, bloggers, and web designers who want to build WordPress sites quickly without hiring a developer.

Key Features

  • AI Website Generator: Automatically generate full website layouts, pages, and content using AI — just describe your business.
  • Elementor Page Builder Integration: Edit every template with Elementor’s drag-and-drop editor. Full compatibility with Elementor widgets and add-ons.
  • Ready-Made Templates: Browse a growing library of professionally designed templates for business, portfolio, blog, landing page, ecommerce, and more.
  • Live Preview: See every design change in real-time before publishing.
  • Brand Customization: Easily update logos, brand colors, fonts, and contact details across your entire site.
  • Mobile-Responsive Design: Every website and landing page is fully responsive on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • SEO-Friendly: Pages are generated following WordPress SEO best practices for better search engine rankings.
  • No Coding Required: A true no-code website builder — build and launch your site entirely from the WordPress dashboard.

Why Choose GW AI Website Builder?

Most website builders still require hours of manual work. GW AI Website Builder is different — it uses AI to generate a complete website tailored to your business, then lets you fine-tune everything with Elementor’s visual editor.

  • Starter-friendly: No technical skills needed. If you can fill out a form, you can build a website.
  • Developer-friendly: Full Elementor compatibility means developers and designers can customize every detail.
  • Fast: Go from zero to a fully built WordPress website in minutes, not days.

Whether you’re creating a business website, a personal blog, a portfolio, or a landing page, this plugin delivers professional results fast.

External Services

This plugin relies on the following external services to function correctly:

  1. GravityWrite API

    • Purpose: Provides AI-powered website content generation, template fetching, and plugin activation verification.
    • Data Sent:
      • Site domain (for license and activation checks)
      • User-entered text prompts (used to generate AI content)
      • Basic usage statistics (e.g., word count, number of imports)
    • When Data Is Sent: Only when specific plugin operations are performed (e.g., generating AI content, templates import, activation).
    • Provider: GravityWrite (Website Learners Private Limited)
    • Terms & Privacy:
      • Terms & Conditions: https://gravitywrite.com/legal/terms-and-conditions
      • Privacy Policy: https://gravitywrite.com/legal/privacy-policy

  2. Plugin Asset Server (plugin.mywpsite.org)

    • Purpose: Hosts essential frontend assets (JavaScript and CSS) needed for the plugin’s UI.
    • Data Sent: No personal or sensitive data; only static assets are served.
    • When Accessed: Every time the plugin loads its UI in WordPress admin or frontend.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Download the Plugin
    Visit: https://gravitywrite.com/ai-website-builder

  2. Upload via WordPress Dashboard

    • Go to Plugins > Add New
    • Click Upload Plugin
    • Select the downloaded ZIP file

  3. Install & Activate

    • Click Install Now
    • Then click Activate

  4. Start Building

    • Go to Gravity Write > AI Website Builder in the admin menu
    • Follow the guided steps to build your website
sections.faq:
Do I need coding knowledge?

No, it’s a complete no-code builder.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes, it integrates seamlessly with Elementor’s interface.

Can I change branding elements like logos and colors?

Yes, you can fully personalize logos, fonts, colors, and more.

Does it support live preview?

Absolutely — all design changes are reflected in real-time.

Is it SEO-friendly?

Yes, generated websites are optimized for search engines.

Are the templates mobile responsive?

Yes, all designs are mobile-friendly by default.
